channel.title: SIREN: score moves of 3+ points
channel.description: Every SIREN reading where the composite moved 3 points or more since the previous reading. SIREN measures how much is happening, not how bad it is. Levels run from 5 (quietest) to 1 (loudest) and describe observable activity tempo against this index’s own record. They are not a probability of harm.
